checks.name: one actual current native head with loaded skin and natural eyes

detail.shadowMethod: per-light native PCF, stochastic single-depth coverage

directional lights with PCF only

checks.name: triangle order cannot change nearest visible hair layer

mobile viewport uses 36k stable covered strands
no-MSAA fallback also writes depth without alpha blending
